name: Tibi
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $335 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Women's tailoring, knitwear, dresses, denim, shoes and bags, sold through its own stores in New York and St. Simons Island, its website and independent boutiques.
origin: Founded in Hong Kong, China in 1997 by Amy Smilovic.

quote.q: Tibi is grounded in the concept of Creative Pragmatism, a design philosophy that balances highly conceptual creativity with utility and functionality.

opview: “Tibi is grounded in the concept of Creative Pragmatism, a design philosophy that balances highly conceptual creativity with utility and functionality.” — Tibi (house), About Us, tibi.com

facts_read.source: brand site; Vinted catalogue; TRR designer directory; B Lab directory; GOTS database

Trousers.lp: Stella Crispy Nylon Pleated Cargo Pant

Dress.hp: 4-Ply Silk Long Sleeve Dress with Ruffle Detail

Outerwear.lp: Active Knit Zipper Detailed Track Jacket

price_read.sublines: none (Tibi Creative Lab graphic tee excluded)

doors.note: US: 2 own doors, New York flagship (120 Wooster St) and St. Simons Island GA (28 Market St). World: the stores page also lists a Vienna studio, by appointment, hosted by partner The Store by Schneeweiss; not a Tibi own door and not US. The stockists page also lists both Tibi stores (St. Simons as '28 Market St Suite 120'); those two rows were not repeated as stockists. 62 US stockists recorded, no ZIPs published.

fibre.sample: stratified sample of 80 across 8 product types (plural and tank/tee types folded), proportional; 276 styles from 578 clothing listings in /collections/view-all,

tech_evidence.names: house fabric families named per style (Tropical Wool, Feather Weight Viscose Neoprene, Skinlike Mercerized Wool, Crispy Nylon, Active Knit, Bio Twill, Cozy Flannel, Eco Poplin and others)
tech_evidence.owned: house names for bought cloth; no mill, patent or process claimed
tech_evidence.share: 61% of sample (49 of 80) carries a fabric-family tag; 46% (37) excluding the generic Cashmere, Denim and Nylon groups

craft_evidence.madein: 0% (no country on product pages or in the feed)
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed — founded 1997 in Hong Kong by Amy Smilovic; based in New York City
craft_evidence.reasoning: Product pages give fibre and style number only, with no country, maker or mill. The about page covers the founding and the design philosophy, not making, so it's a 1.
